{{Top|leg}}
'''Jeboe'i''' was a term used in the sport of [[phrenbi]]. Translating literally as "thieves", the jeboe'i were the neutral pair of teams to each pair of [[osk'y]]. While each pair of osk'y could only compete against each other, their jeboe'i could hinder their progress as there was only one [[b'rrsk]] in play at any team, and all four teams were competing for it.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
